title: Kotak Bekal Misterius di Bangku Taman
theme: Menemukan makna tak terduga dalam rutinitas yang monoton dan beradaptasi dengan kejutan absurd, mengubah pandangan sinis menjadi optimisme unik.

cover.prompt: A tranquil city park at dawn, a peaceful morning ritual. A distant, silhouetted figure gently walks past an antique wooden bench. Focus on the bench, adorned with a few simple, forgotten objects: a subtly worn cloth hat, a translucent, light-colored handkerchief, and a discolored water bottle. Soft, warm golden hour light filters through the gentle foliage, creating a contemplative atmosphere. Shallow depth of field, environmental shot, cinematic composition, evoking quiet observation and gentle intrigue.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: Pak Slamet, seorang satpam sinis di taman kota, terganggu oleh penemuan kotak bekal misterius. Imajinasi liarnya menciptakan skenario konspirasi global, namun ia akhirnya menemukan kebaikan sederhana di baliknya, mengubah pandangan sinisnya menjadi optimisme unik.
meta.target_emotion: Intrigue, amusement, and a sense of understated optimism.
